Iris K: Quick async: post-launch backlog for streaming resume needs a one-pass decision. Propose simple split for next 72h: HOTFIX if (a) customer-blocking OR (b) affects dedicated tenant OR (c) score >= 10. Others -> NEXT-SPRINT. Keep it binary to avoid churn.

Noah D: Agree. Let's define score = severity*3 + ceil(pct_sessions*2) + (onboarding_flag?4:0). Example: sev2, 2.5% -> 2*3 + ceil(2.5*2)=6 + 5 = 11 -> HOTFIX.

Priya M: Good. Also: if support reports >2 separate tickets from different customers for same issue, escalate regardless of score.

Kai W: Noted. Running telemetry query now. support-bot: pull last_7d streams.reconnect errors by tenant and count.

support-bot: Query result (2026-03-14..2026-03-20): reconnect_trunc=167 (1.7%), kv_miss=73 (0.75%), backpressure_freeze=11 (0.11%). Top tenants: gamma-prod=54 (6.9%), delta-inc=31 (4.0%), epsilon-corp=28 (3.8%).

Iris K: gamma-prod and delta-inc are dedicated with active onboarding -> those items auto-hotfix. Assign RI-4001 (gamma reconnect trunc) and RI-4005 (delta reconnect timeout) to HOTFIX lane. Rest go to NEXT-SPRINT grooming.

Noah D: Delivery plan for hotfix: minimal code delta (KV cache guard + idempotency on resume). Canary us-west 45m window. Keep telemetry toggles reversible.

Priya M: Acceptance checklist for hotfix (short): reproduce on replay harness, unit tests, smoke across 3 tenants, perf check (95th <= baseline*1.12), and customer confirmation for dedicated tenants.

Kai W: I'll own canary. deploy-bot: schedule canary for hotfix-RI-4001-4005 -> us-west at 2026-03-25T01:00:00Z (45m).

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: hotfix-RI-4001-4005 -> us-west at 2026-03-25T01:00:00Z (45m). Eng-oncall notified.

Priya M: Next-sprint items (for grooming): SDK retry helper, reconnection best-practices doc, telemetry: capture reconnect session-id for 7 days, and UX sample for retry affordance. I'll create the epic and link tickets.

Iris K: Good. Communications: support will notify gamma-prod and delta-inc that a targeted canary is planned and we'll follow up after verification. Noah, ping here if canary fails.

Noah D: Preflight started: replay traces loaded, smoke harness ready. Will post canary link during window.

Iris K: Thanks team. We'll reconvene only if canary fails or after 48h for a post-rollout review. :white_check_mark:
